svg.text: Processes on one machine, no containers, plain HTTP on 127.0.0.1, ports 19070 to 19511 (scenarios/two-data-spaces/run.sh). Two data spaces, A and B, each with its own portitor-issuer and one consumer.
The organisation runs one connector per data space; in shared mode both use one identity (shown), in separate mode each has its own.
One machine [debug binaries, run as processes]
shared mode: one DID, trusts both issuers, holds
own database, datasets file; trusts only issuer A
own database, datasets file; trusts only issuer B
